hero.title: Apartment Lustig
hero.subtitle: Your oasis of peace and relaxation in the heart of Daruvar. Experience the perfect blend of modern comfort and nature.

footer.about: Your oasis of peace and relaxation. The perfect blend of modern comfort and beautiful nature for a memorable stay.
footer.address: Ul. Antuna Matije Reljkovića 65, Daruvar, Croatia

bento.description: Designed for your complete comfort, Apartment Lustig offers spaciousness and top amenities to make you feel at home.
bento.mainCardDesc: Perfect layout for families or groups. Plenty of space for a peaceful sleep and relaxation.
bento.multimediaDesc: TV in the living room and secure free internet access.
bento.parkingDesc: Your vehicle is safe. Secure spacious parking right next to the property.
bento.accessibilityDesc: Located on the ground floor, also suitable for persons with reduced mobility.
bento.rulesDesc: Smoking and pets are not allowed.
bento.kitchenDesc: Everything needed for quick and easy meal preparation.
bento.locationDesc: We are located in a peaceful environment of beautiful nature. In the immediate vicinity are the sports fishpond (lake), the popular Aquae Balisse Thermal Water Park, healing Daruvar Spa, and the Veterans Center.
